what: A band of 10 horizontal lines whose thickness grows by a power curve from the top (hairline) to the bottom (11% of the band height). When it enters the screen the lines unfold .05s apart. The wipe type opens a face cut from the bottom upward (.9s power3.inOut), the reveal type grows from the bottom-left point, 30px down and 0× scale (1.3s power2.inOut), and the grow type extends horizontally from the left (1.3s power2.inOut). While the band passes the screen center and exits upward, line i moves down by i/(n−1)×100, so lower lines spread further apart (scrub). Laid under the hero photo, above the banner and below the portrait photo as a section boundary.

options.look: ”wipe” (default — opens from the bottom) · ”reveal” (grows from the lower left) · ”grow” (horizontally from the left)
options.count: Number of lines when drawn directly, default 10 — if the element already has an svg (rect, path) inside, those lines are used
options.end: End — default ”bottom bottom” (”bottom top” when scrub is on)
options.scrub: true or a number of seconds ties the unfolding to scroll (touch devices play it once) — strip laid upside down above the banner
options.drift: If ”off”, turns off the line-spacing spread (original no-vertical)
options.spread: Maximum spread (svg units, based on band height 215), default 100

use: · Reversed: style="transform:scaleY(-1)" + scrub: true

from.where: index.html below hero (look: reveal) · above banner (scrub: true, reversed) · below portrait photo (wipe) — shared.css .k-stripes
